flawless: The tide turns where it pleases, and today it pleased me. Not a drop of me spilled.
You fought like a fish on the sand. Go and dry off, landwalker.
solid: You splashed me a few times. The reef has known rougher waves.
A good current in that deck of yours. Mine ran deeper.
close: Saltwater and stars, I was nearly washed out to sea!
My gills are still flapping. I'm staying near the reef for a while.
